A player with 26 [[Smithing]] can make the chainbody by using three [[iron bar]]s on an [[anvil]] while carrying a [[hammer]], granting 75 Smithing [[experience]]. An iron chainbody is required for the [[Black Knights' Fortress]], [[King's Ransom]], and [[While Guthix Sleeps]] quests. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +10 |dslash = +15 |dcrush = +19 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +12 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Iron chainbody equipped male.png|150px]] |altimage = [[File:Iron chainbody equipped female.png|150px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 26 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 75 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Iron bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Iron chainbody }} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Iron chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Iron chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Iron chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Iron chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Iron chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Iron chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Iron chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Iron chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Iron chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Iron chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Iron chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
